description_en: Schedules the release of a security instance
name: ReleaseInstance

parameters.description_en: The ID of the security instance. This must be a DDoS security instance ID in the format of esa-ddos-*. You can call the ListDDoSInstances operation to obtain the ID. Site instance IDs in the format of esa-site-* are not supported.
parameters.description_zh: 安全实例 ID（须为 DDoS 安全实例 ID（格式 esa-ddos-*），通过 ListDDoSInstances API 获取；站点实例 ID（格式 esa-site-*）不适用）。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the security instance. This must be a DDoS security instance ID in the format of esa-ddos-*. You can call the ListDDoSInstances operation to obtain the ID. Site instance IDs in the format of esa-site-* are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 安全实例 ID（须为 DDoS 安全实例 ID（格式 esa-ddos-*），通过 ListDDoSInstances API 获取；站点实例 ID（格式 esa-site-*）不适用）
